scripts.dev: concurrently -n "site,web,api" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/site" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/ui && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/site && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y
